# jumpcloud_policy (Resource)

Manages a JumpCloud policy (MDM configuration profile or device policy).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jumpcloud_policy" "example" {
  name        = "FileVault Enforcement"
  template_id = "policy-template-id"
  state       = "active"
  notes       = "Enforces FileVault encryption on all macOS devices"
  values = jsonencode({
    enabled = true
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the policy.

### Optional

- `notes` (String) Notes or description for the policy.
- `state` (String) The state of the policy: active or disabled.
- `template_id` (String) The ID of the policy template to base this policy on.
- `values` (String) JSON-encoded policy values/settings. Structure depends on the policy template.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the policy.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import jumpcloud_policy.example <policy-id>
```
